triggers.desc: A single file, the data is its path.
An object holding the list under `itemsKey` (`obibaFiles` for that format, `files` otherwise).

label.desc: Label of the upload button (also `label` on the schema property); defaults to the `files.upload` message.

multiple.desc: Several files; defaults to true unless `maxItems` is 1 (always false for a path control).

accept.desc: Accepted file types of the file picker (`.pdf`, `image/*`...); `acceptedFileTypes` (string or array) is accepted too.

acceptedFileTypes.desc: Alias of `accept` (angular-schema-form convention), a string or an array of types.

emptyMessage.desc: Text displayed read-only when there is no file; defaults to the `files.empty` message.

itemsKey.desc: Object controls: property holding the file list (`obibaFiles` for that format, `files` otherwise).

uploadUrl.desc: Declarative flow: the files are `POST`ed there as multipart form data, with a progress bar.

uploadHeaders.desc: Headers sent with the upload, metadata and delete requests.

withCredentials.desc: Send the cookies with a cross-origin upload.

pathKey.desc: Dotted path of the value to store, in the JSON response of the upload; without it the whole JSON body is the file item.

metadataUrl.desc: Template with `{id}`: after the upload, the file item is fetched from this URL with the id found in the `Location` response header (the Mica temporary file flow).

deleteUrl.desc: Template with `{id}`, `DELETE`d when a file uploaded in this session (`justUploaded`) is removed.

downloadUrl.desc: Template with the item properties (`/ws/files/{id}/{fileName}`), used as the link of the file name; without it, `url` or `href` of the item.

missingFiles.desc: The control is required and has no file (once the data exists); `validationMessage.missingFiles`.

minItems.desc: Object controls: fewer files than `minItems` (schema, or the filtrex `min` rule); `validationMessage.minItems`.

data.desc: Path controls store the path (`pathKey` of the response). List controls store file items `{ id, fileName, size, ... }`: everything returned by the server is kept, `fileName` and `size` are filled from the selected file when missing, and `justUploaded: true` marks the files uploaded in this session. Programmatic flow: `config.fileUpload` of `QJsonForm` with `upload(file, context)` returning the item (or the path), `remove(item, context)` and `downloadUrl(item, context)`. The errors are reported with the `files` keyword.
